title: Brazilian Bean Wrap
description: A flavorful and nutritious wrap filled with sautéed Brazilian-style beans, crunchy sprouts, and wrapped in a nourishing tortilla.

ingredients.name: Nourishing whole wheat tortilla
ingredients.notes: Large or split into smaller wraps

instructions: 1. Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
2. Sauté the sliced sausage (if using) until browned, about 3-4 minutes.
3. Add the cooked black beans, cabbage (if using), and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
4. Warm the tortilla by wrapping it in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
5. Assemble the wrap by spooning the bean mixture onto the center of the tortilla.
6. Top with edible sprouts and chopped cilantro (if using).
7. Fold the bottom edge of the tortilla up over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll the wrap up tightly.
8. Slice in half and serve immediately.
